comment: Live Google Sheets spreadsheet IDs for the SALE/DISPATCH registers by fiscal year. These are goods-dispatched (primary sale) registers — NOT order-booking sheets. SALE and ORDER BOOKING are separate measures from separate spreadsheets and must never be confused. Columns: Serial, InvoiceNo, Date, BillFrom, Customer.Name, City, Destination, ItemCode, Color, Quantity, MRP, SaleRate, TaxableValue, GROUP, STATION, STATE, STATE HEAD, MONTH.

sap_source.comment: Raw SAP export (56-col) from which the 2026-27 register above is derived. Used for data-freshness cross-check in Data Health only — never read for analytics.
